definition: On the #435 capacity model read as an Ontic, at actual world false: the root exists, exists at every accessible world, has no existing supporter at any world under the route's esse-causation read as support, has an intervention-response capacity at every world, and esse-causes the other being, which is contingent. It mentions no attribute of the root.
note: Stipulative comparison notion for #468. It is what both candidates share, not a definition of God or of a physical ground. Reading esse-causation as support holds for these tables only. See docs/notes/physical-ground-468.md.
